positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Created connectors for data sources to Slack security data warehouse (SDW)
- Wrote AWS Lambda functions to automate preprocessing and ingestion of security related data into SDW
- Designed a Bolt for Python Slack app which retrieved SDW data and automated SOX related tasks
- Slack app replaced the Risk & Compliance team’s existing process for determining SOX ITGC compliance

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on PoCs within the Private Wealth Management team
- Implemented a pipeline which transformed xml data into Snowflake ingestible tables
- Collaborated with multiple team members to generalize PoC code
- Utilized Python 3 and Snowflake

positions.title: Student Leadership Program (Women in Tech)
positions.description:
- 1 of 30 students selected to participate in professional development series
- Exposure to innovative technology and grew professional skills with Accenture leadership
- Topics included Cloud, AI, Blockchain, Virtual Reality, and Security
- Bimonthly meetings with mentors

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with Refocus employees to create beta release product
- Wrote production code consisting of Django REST API endpoints and frontend features
- Utilized endpoints for machine learning models, autofilled PDF forms, and analyzing user data
- Gave a technical presentation to the company and its advisors
- Used Python 3, MongoDB, AWS S3 / SageMaker, Angular 9

positions.title: Pinterest Engage Scholar
positions.description:
- Unpaid professional development series for 40 students
- Weekly C++ coding challenges and meetings with my Pinterest mentor on the Security team
- Weekly sessions consisting of developing interpersonal and technical skills
- Engaged in various software engineering workshops lead by Pinterest employees

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted 30 students in the Introduction to Computer Science class
- Helped with implementing Java programs and fixing compile/runtime errors
- Responsible for teaching how to design and code the game, Snake
- Explicated basic data structures and syntax

positions.title: Girls Who Code
positions.description:
- 1 of 20 girls in the GWC Summer Immersion program at Amazon
- 1 of 4 girls which coded and presented a website about immigration to 10 employees
- Collaborated with peers on multiple programming projects and developed interpersonal skills
- Learned Python, Java, Javascript, CSS, and C++ for Arduino

honors.title: UC Davis Community Service Award Bronze
honors.description:
- Awarded for my involvement in Project RISHI to promote sustainability in India
- Worked to advance the computer literacy of villagers in Andimadam

honors.title: Aspirations In Computing Rising Star Award
honors.issuer: Issued by National Center for Women & Information Technology · Jan 2019
